purpose: Determine whether the negative JPFM-3C POSS exact-day point estimate survives a low-dimensional finite-sample randomization analysis that does not rely on a high-dimensional NB2 covariance estimate.

frozen_cohort.unit: actually observed Palomar night also passing the frozen solar patrol opportunity gate
frozen_cohort.event_definition: same-day official NOAA H-alpha detailed event record

primary_statistic.name: log_crude_rate_ratio
primary_statistic.formula: log[(sum candidates on flare nights / sum tiles on flare nights) / (sum candidates on non-flare nights / sum tiles on non-flare nights)]
primary_statistic.positive: higher POSS rate on flare nights
primary_statistic.negative: lower POSS rate on flare nights

preserves: all Palomar night dates and candidate/tile observations
total number of flare and non-flare labels within each calendar year
primary_null.enumeration: Enumerate every distinct within-year placement of the observed number of non-flare labels; no Monte Carlo approximation when the Cartesian product is tractable.

influence_gate.method: For each observed non-flare control night, remove that single night and recompute the crude rate ratio without refitting any nuisance model.
influence_gate.interpretation: A result dominated by one control night is classified CONTROL_LEVERAGE_UNSTABLE even if an exact permutation tail is small.

sensitivity.role: pre-specified sensitivity only; cannot rescue a failed 720-minute primary

admission_rule.negative_pattern_retained: primary lower-tail exact p<0.05 AND all leave-one-control-out rate ratios remain <1

forbidden: No threshold or event-definition tuning after 3D outcome.
No use of the 360-minute sensitivity to override the 720-minute primary.
No reintroduction of high-dimensional nuisance adjustment into the 3D primary statistic.
